description: Check a speech job created earlier. Returns status (PENDING | SUCCESS | ERROR) and audio_url once SUCCESS. Never guess or fetch an audio URL before SUCCESS.

job_type.description: single = text_to_speech, multi = multi_voice_to_speech, srt = srt_to_speech.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds the server waits for the audio before returning. If the job is still PENDING, call get_job_status later with the returned job_id.

name: get_job_status
title: Job status
